item.title: FAMU engineering student inspires the next generation with new children's book about STEM
item.description: FAMU student Madison Devoux wrote "Hope is an Engineer," a book that is encouraging young girls to pursue engineering careers. She's already sold more than 100 copies.

item.title: Wakulla County School Board approves rezoning to address Crawfordville Elementary School overcrowding
item.description: After the Tuesday WCSB vote, families east of Crawfordville Highway and south of Dr. Martin Luther King Memorial Road will attend Medart Elementary starting next school year.

item.title: Lowndes County citizens push back on potential data centers during town hall
item.description: Experts and neighbors spoke at the Tuesday town hall which focused on how a data center project would affect water usage, utility rates, the local economy, and infrastructure.
